speaker: CIVILIAN AMARA
text: My name is Amara. I choose to keep it.

speaker: CIVILIANS
text: I am Elias. My name is Nia. I remember mine.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: No one asked them to prove it. They just said it.

speaker: AURA
text: The records are theirs. So is the next word.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Water, shelter, transit. The gates are answering to people again.

speaker: TITAN
text: They carried those names through every locked door.

speaker: SURYA // COMMS
text: The queue is moving. They are choosing where to go.

speaker: KAITO
text: We helped make the choice possible. What comes next is theirs to decide.
